drafts.title: The Clash
drafts.reasoning: This scene highlights the contrasting methods of solving cases between Captain Hank and Officer John, setting up their conflict while incorporating Noel's background as the quieter support in the background.
drafts.scene: In a dimly lit conference room filled with tension, two maps are laid out on a table. The sound of typing can be heard from Noel, who is diligently working on some reports. Sierra sits quietly nearby, reading through evidence notes.

dialogue.line: You know what I don't get about you, rookie? You act like the whole city depends on your snacks.
Hey, it’s all part of my presentation strategy! Plus, we’re trying to keep spirits up around here.
Not if I’m doing my job right. And hey, maybe that’s how we catch our guy – by breaking bread together!
That’s the most dangerous kind of thinking for a cop. We deal in facts, not... goodwill.
Anyway, enough talk. Let's go over these leads again before we send out more officers into that mess you call an investigation.
Right behind you, Captain. But first, let me check this one last email and make sure I have everything squared away.
